design_description: A deep forest-green kit built around a layered woodland theme. The jersey uses multiple dark green tones, with pine-tree silhouettes concentrated toward the lower body and rough diagonal tonal textures fading across the upper section. Because every layer sits within the same green family, the forest reads as depth and texture rather than as a printed picture, and the shirt still looks like a solid dark kit from distance. Clean white twin stripes run along the shoulders, with matching white detailing around the collar and sleeve cuffs, giving the darker pattern a crisp contrast and a clear structural frame. The back continues the same forest treatment, with the tree line rising from the hem and the upper area left calmer, finished with a large white name and number that stay sharp against the dark base. The shorts stay mostly solid dark green with matching white side stripes, so the full kit holds together without repeating the forest graphic everywhere. Overall it has a rugged, understated Pacific Northwest feel, with the pine forest integrated into the kit rather than used as a separate graphic.
